finalText:
**Drafted 4.2.0 in [CHANGELOG.md:3](CHANGELOG.md:3).** 380 commits, 3 things users feel.

Only one real feature. Webhook retries with backoff. The rest are 11 distinct fixes and 4 perf wins. I folded perf into nothing since none change behavior.

Three breaking items need your call:

| Change | Risk |
|---|---|
| Expired token now `401`, was `403` | Breaks callers keyed on `403` |
| Internal error types no longer re-exported | Breaks imports, never documented |
| v1 export route dropped | Marked "unused" in the PR |

Two open questions. `docs: note the minimum node version` landed 5 times but no `engines` change. Confirm the floor. And the empty-allowlist fix may flip an insecure default. Worth checking before you ship.
